entries.title: Merging follows the merge types your project allows
entries.body: When you press Merge on a merge card, Infinitary now checks which merge types your project allows on GitHub or GitLab and uses one of them. A project that turns off squash merges gets a merge commit or a rebase instead of a refused merge. If your project allows none that fit, nothing is sent and the card says which setting to change.
entries.noPicture: The merge card looks the same; what changes is the merge it sends to GitHub or GitLab.
